description: This file is a PHP source code defining the 'Language' class within the OpenCart admin localisation controllers. It manages listing, editing, creating, and deleting language entries, including handling data, rendering forms, and processing save operations.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: Controller class for managing languages in the OpenCart admin localisation module. It provides methods for listing, editing, creating, saving, and deleting language records, as well as rendering the related forms.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Sets up the language management page, loads necessary language and data, and renders the language list view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the AJAX request to retrieve the list of languages with filtering, sorting, and pagination, and returns the view with data.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and formats the list of languages based on current filters and sorting, returning the language list view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the request to display the list of available languages, with proper sorting and pagination.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for adding or editing a language, loading existing data if available.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes the submission of the language create/edit form, saving data to the database after permission check.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected language records after permission validation, used for bulk delete operations.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Builds and returns the formatted list of languages including sorting, filtering, and pagination details.
